::: {.notes}
As a wrap-up to the surveydown study: the platform also collaborates with the new agentic AI engineering workflow. I built the surveydown-skill, a single skill that teaches AI agents like Claude Code the whole platform. It covers four capabilities: creating a survey, connecting a database, deploying online, and recording a video walkthrough, and each one is a full workflow rather than a loose hint. The skill is open source on GitHub.
:::
